title: The High Monsoon
author: Oscar Thornbury
blurb: Freya Okafor, a storm chaser who owes money to dangerous optimists, keeps moving because stopping costs more. But when the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides before the monsoon makes landfall.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
